description.zh:
集合名。

> 您可以通过[CreateCollection](~~2401497~~)接口创建，通过[ListCollections](~~2401503~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The name of the collection.

>  You can call the [CreateCollection](~~2401497~~) operation to create a vector collection and call the [ListCollections](~~2401503~~) operation to query a list of vector collections.

description.zh:
存储预留模式实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the instance in reserved storage mode.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 授权目标，即此命名空间有此向量数据集的相应权限。
description.en: The name of the namespace to which you want to grant the vector collection permissions.

description.zh:
授权类型，可选值：

- rw：读写权限
- ro：只读权限
- none：删除权限
description.en:
The type of the permissions that you want to grant. Valid values:

*   rw: the read and write permissions.
*   ro: the read-only permission.
*   none: the delete permission.

description.zh:
具有rds_superuser权限的管理账户名称。

> 您可以通过控制台->账号管理来创建账号，或者通过[CreateAccount](~~2361789~~)接口创建。
description.en:
The name of the manager account that has the rds_superuser permission.

>  You can create an account on the Account Management page of the AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL console or by calling the [CreateAccount](~~2361789~~) operation.
The password of the manager account.

description.zh:
命名空间。

> 您通过[ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~)查看列表。
description.en:
The name of the namespace.

>  You can call the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation to query a list of namespaces.
The region ID of the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb grant-collection --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --collection document --grant-to-namespace othernamespace --grant-type rw --manager-account testaccount --manager-account-password testpassword --namespace mynamespace --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb GrantCollection --region cn-hangzhou --ManagerAccountPassword testpassword --GrantToNamespace othernamespace --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --ManagerAccount testaccount --Collection document --GrantType rw --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Namespace mynamespace
